title: Mass Hierarchies Without Mixing: Abelian Froggatt-Nielsen Models with Uncharged Left-Handed Doublets
summary: Abelian flavor charges on right-handed fermions produce left-handed anarchy: we prove that all abelian discrete Froggatt-Nielsen models with uncharged left-handed doublets yield Haar-random PMNS and CKM matrices, regardless of $\mathbb{Z}_N$ group order, charge assignment, or Majorana mass structure. Scanning $\mathbb{Z}_3$ through $\mathbb{Z}_7$ with 12 charge assignments and $10^5$ Monte Carlo samples each, we demonstrate that the mass spectrum failure previously identified for $\mathbb{Z}_3$ -- the seesaw over-suppression mechanism that pushes $Δm^2_{21}/Δm^2_{31}$ to $\sim 10^{-11}$ --…
